reviews.reason: RunConversation is keyed by application and selected record/run. Its mount initializes the conversation generation and resets paging receipts; stale continuations are fenced on unmount. Clearing forwardFailed starts a new cursor catch-up attempt, not a mirror of a prop.

The first effect resets one conversation generation. The second responds to polled pages, merging receipts and starting at most one forward catch-up. These are related updates in the same effect, not a chain of user actions. The deferred-forward test polls while an after request is pending and checks that pages drain without parallel requests.

A latest-page refresh cannot reconstruct prepended history, the original history anchor, or forward pages received since it. record-history retains loaded turns across a failed older-page request; imported-forward drains later pages from committed cursors.
